origin.summary: Workout 1 of the 2021 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: An ascending couplet of wall climbs and double-unders, both climbing through the same six-step scheme.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2021/1 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09; bodyweight only, no Rx load
